title: Invoke retry-annotated methods with coarse time units
summary: Both coarse retry units now allow an immediately successful call. A real retry also recovered at attempt two with the very large seconds bound and its millisecond equivalent.

change.description: Retry annotation processing converts millisecond and coarser numeric attributes with saturation. The default unlimited maximum delay can therefore coexist with a seconds or minutes setting.

notes: The parent seconds conversion raised ArithmeticException before target entry. A representable explicit maximum worked through the advised bean on both revisions.
